_about: English text for the airport pages, the airports hub and the country hubs (built by tools/site/pages/airports.mjs). Placeholders are {name}. Sentences are chosen by the airport's facts (see tools/site/lib/airportcopy.mjs), not by synonyms. Other languages can follow these keys later.
airport.title: {name} ({code}) map and runways | Short Final
airport.desc: Map of {name} in {place}: {runways} runways, the longest {longest} ft, with the layout from OpenStreetMap.
airport.descNoRunways: Map of {name} in {place}, with the layout from OpenStreetMap and public airport data.
airport.descShort: Map and runways of {name} ({code}) in {place}, from OpenStreetMap and public airport data.
airport.demoNote: The browser demo is free and gives 3 free games a day with simulated planes.
airport.playStore: Get Short Final on Google Play
airport.mapCaption: Map: OpenStreetMap contributors, captured {date}. North is up and the drawing is simplified. Each runway is labelled at its ends.
airport.mapNone: The OpenStreetMap layout for this airport has nothing to draw.
airport.runwaysNone: Our runway list has no entries for this airport.
airport.runwaysNote: Runway idents and sizes from OurAirports. The runway headings in the source do not always match the idents, so only the idents are shown.
airport.routesNote: Published route data from the snapshot of {date}. These are standing schedules, not live flights, and they can be out of date. Counts are routes in that snapshot.
airport.routesNone: The route snapshot of {date} has no scheduled routes for this airport.
airport.airlinesOther: Also flying here, shown by airline code: {codes}.
airport.nearbyNote: The closest airports that have a map and a page here.
airport.finalBody: Short Final is free on Google Play. Pick the airport, draw a path for each plane, and bring it down on the right runway.
airport.sources: Sources: airport and runway data from OurAirports (public domain). Map data from OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL). Routes from Virtual Radar Server standing data (CC0), snapshot of {date}.
para.open.iata: {name} ({iata}) is a {size} airport in {place}, with the ICAO code {code}.
para.open.noIata: {name} ({code}) is a {size} airport in {place}. Our airport list gives it no IATA code.
para.rank: It is number {rank} on the ACI World list of the busiest airports, with {pax} million passengers in 2025.
para.run.one: It has one runway, {ends}, {len} ft long and {width} ft wide, with {surface}.
para.run.oneNoWidth: It has one runway, {ends}, {len} ft long, with {surface}.
para.run.two: Its two runways are {a} and {b}. The longer one, {ends}, is {len} ft.
para.run.few: Its {count} runways are {list}. The longest, {ends}, is {len} ft.
para.run.many: It has {count} runways, from {short} ft to {len} ft long. The longest is {ends}.
para.run.none: Our runway list has no entries for it, so the page shows the map only.
para.surface.allHard: All of them have hard surfaces.
para.map.none: The OpenStreetMap layout shows only the runways.
para.routes.one: In the route snapshot of {date}, {airline} has {routes} routes through {code}.
para.routes.many: In the route snapshot of {date}, {airlines} airlines have {routes} routes through {code}.
para.links.one: Its only linked airport in the snapshot is {a}.
para.links.two: Its most frequent links are {a} and {b}.
para.links.many: Its most frequent links are {a}, {b} and {c}.
para.routes.none: The route snapshot of {date} has no scheduled routes for {code}.
para.play: Try {code} in the free browser demo, or land its traffic in the Android game.
hub.title: Airport maps and runways | Short Final
hub.desc: Search more than {airports} airports by code, name or city, with runways and maps where we have them.
hub.lead: Search {total} airports by code, name or city. {mapped} of them have a map from OpenStreetMap, with runways and, where OpenStreetMap has them, taxiways, aprons, terminals and gates, and a page of their own.
hub.searchLabel: Search airports by code, name or city
hub.searchHint: Try a code such as DEN or LHR, a name, or a city.
hub.noScript: Search needs JavaScript. The lists below work without it.
hub.busiestNote: Passengers from ACI World's 2025 results, as the game lists them. Airports with a map link to their page.
hub.countriesNote: Each country with at least one map. The number is how many maps it has.
hub.status.more: Showing the first {n}. Type more letters to narrow the list.
hub.status.none: No airports match. Try a shorter code or a city name.
hub.status.error: Search is not available right now. Use the country list below.
country.title: Airports in {country} with maps | Short Final
country.desc: {n} airports in {country} with OpenStreetMap layouts, runways and lengths. Play any of them in Short Final.
country.lead: {n} of the {total} airports in {country} have a map here, with their runways and lengths. The rest have no map yet.
country.more: Showing the {shown} largest of the {n} airports with maps. The search on the airports page finds the others.
flights.title: Flying near {place} right now
flights.lead: Real aircraft, from public broadcasts. The list refreshes every minute while this page is open.
flights.busy: Live data is behind for this airport right now, so this list may be a few minutes old.
flights.none: No aircraft within {radius} nm right now.
